items.text:
Travel and Commuting Policy — Section 4: Service Disruptions

When a train strike or other industrial action is announced, staff who normally commute by rail may work from home without prior approval, provided they notify their line manager by the end of the previous working day. Requests for alternative travel reimbursement should be submitted through the expenses portal with the strike notice attached. The policy applies to all permanent and fixed-term employees across the three office locations.

The People Operations team maintains a weekly disruption bulletin, and the facilities assistant collates rail alerts from National Rail into a single summary each Monday. Employees are encouraged to check the bulletin before planning office attendance during periods of industrial action.

Any exception to this section must be approved in writing by a director. Questions about the policy should go to peopleops@meridian-labs.example. The current version (v3.1) replaces the interim guidance issued last autumn and takes effect from 1 April.

items.text: Customer feedback summary — Northwind Telecom retail, February. Satisfaction averaged 4.1 out of 5 across 612 responses, up from 3.8 in January. Most comments praised the in-store staff and the speed of the phone upgrade process, though a few customers noted long waits at the Meadowhall branch on Saturdays. The review-analysis tool tagged 14 responses as mentioning billing confusion, which the support lead is following up. Overall the trend is positive heading into the spring promotion.
